mentions.name: Wait
mentions.description: A self-hostable, CORS-enabled, headless waitlist system that collects emails from landing pages and writes them to Google Sheets. Static landing pages send cross-domain AJAX requests directly to the Wait server (no iframe), so the site owner keeps full control of form styling and post-submission actions; it runs cheaply on a small VPS (about $4/month on OVHCloud).
mentions.problem: Collecting emails into waitlists across many landing pages, where iframe-embedded or provider-locked form widgets make styling and post-submission actions hard to customize.
mentions.audience: People launching landing pages who want to collect emails into waitlists
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on Wait: https://github.com/tanin47/wait, a self-hostable CORS-enabled headless waitlist system that connects to Google Sheets.
